@conjureos/ui

Every primitive class and color token in the library, rendered live. Open this file in any browser; no build step required. Source on GitHub, package on npm.

v0.1.1 MIT

Color tokens

Reach for these via var(--cui-accent) etc. Wrap content in class="cui-tokens" if you want the palette without primitive classes.

#7c6af7
--cui-accent-soft

Typography

Heading

<h1 class="cui-heading">Heading</h1>

Subheading text

<p class="cui-subheading">Subheading text</p>
Muted secondary text
<span class="cui-muted">Muted secondary text</span>
Dim tertiary / disabled text
<span class="cui-dim">Dim tertiary / disabled text</span>

Buttons

<button class="cui-button">Default</button>
<button class="cui-button cui-button--primary">Primary</button>
<button class="cui-button cui-button--ghost">Ghost</button>
<button class="cui-button cui-button--primary cui-button--pill">
  Pill primary
</button>
<button class="cui-button" disabled>Disabled</button>

Pills (status tags)

Default Success Warning Error 
<span class="cui-pill">Default</span>
<span class="cui-pill cui-pill--success">Success</span>
<span class="cui-pill cui-pill--warn">Warning</span>
<span class="cui-pill cui-pill--error">Error</span>

Chips (interactive tags)

<button class="cui-chip">Filter one</button>
<button class="cui-chip cui-chip--active">Active filter</button>

Inputs

<label class="cui-label">
  Plain input
  <input class="cui-input" type="text" />
</label>

Cards

Default card

Translucent surface with a hairline border.

<div class="cui-card">
  <h3 class="cui-heading">Default card</h3>
  <p class="cui-muted">Translucent surface...</p>
</div>

Interactive card

Hover me. Accent-tinted lift on hover.

<div class="cui-card cui-card--interactive">
  ...
</div>

Hero card

Purple to blue gradient backing for headline surfaces.

<div class="cui-card cui-card--hero">
  ...
</div>

Layout helpers

Stacked item one
Stacked item two
Stacked item three
<div class="cui-stack-v">
  <div class="cui-card">Item one</div>
  <div class="cui-card">Item two</div>
</div>
Left Right 
<div class="cui-stack-h cui-stack-h--between">
  <span>Left</span>
  <span>Right</span>
</div>
